sources.license: Producer CC BY-SA3.0, no audio redistribution

limits: Low recording level and derived attenuation are not verified soft phonation or whispering
Same three known corpus speakers; median confirmation is not independent speaker validation
Automatic outputs are conditional gate replay of one actual manual decode; no assertion every input triggers a product review
Noise target absent reference does not imply no background speech; no CER or semantic hallucination count
Character alignment deletions/insertions are not semantic omission/hallucination event counts
No raw audio, reference or output text, model files, local paths or user vault content published

route_semantics.automatic: conditional candidate availability replay, not actual job eligibility or deletion of stored transcript
route_semantics.boost_automatic: same conditional replay with detector-only amplified activity, original PCM ASR

actual_product_flow.scope: Isolated product functions and actual native/MLX inference; actual initial Whisper, not seeded transcript; no installed UI/microphone or user vault writes

whisper_diagnostic.scope: Post-baseline diagnostic, all6low20 and9controls, not independent validation or default-policy change

adoption.reason: Added output on manually SIL-labeled controls; one no-VAD low-level speech regression; recovered detector candidates remained CER94-100pct

timing_scope: Per CLI or short-lived worker call with setup/model loading; Mac load/order not controlled, not a latency ranking
